# Terms of Service for CloudSync

**Last Updated:** October 26, 2023

This definition encompasses all features currently available and those that may be added or modified in the future, provided they are accessible through your account. The Service is designed to facilitate the secure storage, synchronization, and sharing of digital files across multiple devices and user accounts.

The term "User" refers to any individual or entity that registers for an account to access the Service. This includes both the primary account holder and any authorized sub-users or team members added to the account by the primary holder. It is important to note that while the Company provides the infrastructure for Content storage, the Company does not own, claim, or have rights to your Content unless explicitly stated otherwise in these Terms.

If you do not agree to the new pricing terms, you may cancel your Subscription prior to the effective date of the price increase.
